run_time_prompt_addition:
## Output

Generate exactly one image. Save it as `out.png` in the current working directory (the workspace root).
model_note: The image_gen call does not appear in the --json event stream, so the model name is not reported.
copied_into_workspace_by: gen.mjs (copied out.png out of the Codex temp dir)

screening.gaps: smallest pixel gap 49 px (tail/jaw), smallest box gap 30 px (turn_side/body), no box overlaps, frame margin 29 px
screening.legs: 17.2% of standing height below the hem (tile 18.4%)
screening.appeal_vs_v3_4: Near-trace of v3_4's side view: same head, eye bump, snout, two tooth tips, scalloped tail, hoodie and mitten; the friendliest and cleanest of the three.
screening.material: Best of the three: finer grain, smooth flat fields, thin pale rim; still faint fibre mottling, and no strongly torn edge.
screening.parts: Parts closest to the cutter conventions: arms horizontal shoulder-left, legs upright foot +x, tail -x, jaw cream with three tooth tips.
screening.flags: leg tops drawn as lighter ellipses (a cylinder top, dimensional) and the pocket has an embossed rim; turn_front has a cream throat patch that reads as a blank mask; some alpha<16 green dust around pieces (cut.mjs clears it).
screening.checklist: Method: full-size Read of the PNG; composites over #1E2440 and #808080 (evidence/asset-gator-sheet/contact.jpg); turn_side beside the frozen tile's gator at equal height (beside_v3_4.jpg); hoodie at 2.6x beside the tile's; measure.mjs gaps (gaps.txt); legs.mjs leg share (legs.txt). Shared by all three: real alpha (flat background), 14 alpha islands = 14 pieces, no text or labels, no cast or drop shadows, palette green/cream with black only in turn_side's pupil and nostril dots. head, turn_front and turn_head34 painted blank as asked. Shared misses: turn_head34 is a side head (snout to +x), not a 3/4 front view; turn_front shows no muzzle, so front-on he reads as a frog or bear; the asked 40 px is met between pixels but not between boxes or to the frame edge; resolution about 425 px of figure height, too low for the close-ups in s06/s15/s18 H.
